title: Accounts Assistant - Hybrid
description:
Exciting opportunity in Ross-on-Wye for an Accounts Assistant to join an active and busy accounts function in a nationally recognised company in a full time role.

You will support the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable function, assisting with supplier payments, bank reconciliations, credit control, customer and supplier queries, and maintaining accurate financial records. Full training on company process and systems provided.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices accurately and within deadlines.
- Support supplier payment runs and maintain supplier accounts.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve invoice or payment queries.
- Process daily banking transactions and complete bank reconciliations.
- Assist with month-end journals and financial reconciliations.
- Support credit control by monitoring aged debt and chasing overdue payments.
- Respond to customer and supplier queries in a professional manner.
- Maintain accurate financial records, documentation and account data.
- Work with colleagues to identify and support process improvements.

Key Attributes
- Previous finance or accounts experience essential
- Reliable, team player
- Confident communicator

Hours: Full time: Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5pm (1hr lunch) - 37.5h pw with option to work from home up to 1-2 days per week once fully trained and settled.

Salary: £12.92 - £14.36 per hour + benefits including:
- Hybrid working
- Free parking
- EAP Programme.
- 25 days holiday PLUS bank holidays + annual leave purchase scheme (pro rata for temp)
- Birthday day off.

title: Accounts Receivable Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will be joining an established business based in Ledbury that is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable professional to join their Finance team on an initial 6-month temporary basis, with the potential to go permanent.
Your new role
This will be a predominantly Accounts Receivable and Credit Control focused role, with some crossover into wider Accounts Assistant duties.

Responsibilities will include:
- Managing Accounts Receivable and credit control
- Chasing outstanding debt via phone and email
- Allocating customer payments and reconciling the sales ledger
- Carrying out credit checks and maintaining credit limits
- Processing invoices and credit notes
- Producing aged debt and AR reports
- Intercompany invoicing and reconciliations
- Supporting month-end and balance sheet reconciliations
- Resolving billing queries and supporting process improvements

What you'll need to succeed
You will have previous experience within Accounts Receivable and/or Credit Control, with confidence managing a busy ledger and chasing outstanding debt. You will ideally be available at short notice and comfortable working fully on-site in Ledbury.
What you'll get in return
This is an ASAP start, initially for 6 months, with the potential to become permanent. The role is paying up to £18 per hour, depending on experience, and offers an early finish on Fridays.

title: Accounts Receivable Urgently Needed
description:
Reed Accountancy & Finance are delighted to be supporting a successful and growing organisation in the search for an experienced Credit Controller to join their busy finance team on a 6-month fixed-term contract.

Please note this is an Office based role working Mon - Fri 08:30 - 17:00

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive finance professional who enjoys building strong customer relationships, reducing aged debt, and contributing to process improvements within a fast-paced environment. The role will play a key part in managing a high-volume accounts receivable function, processing over 4,500 invoices per month.

The Role

As Credit Controller, you will be responsible for ensuring timely collections, maintaining accurate customer accounts, and supporting the wider finance team with accounts receivable activities. You will also contribute to ongoing systems and process improvements that support business growth and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the end-to-end credit control process, ensuring timely collection of outstanding debts.
- Proactively chase overdue payments via telephone, email, and structured collection processes.
- Build strong working relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment and billing issues.
- Allocate customer payments and prepayments accurately, minimising unallocated cash.
- Reconcile sales ledger balances, customer prepayments, and payments on account.
- Upload customer invoices to online portals and monitor acceptance for payment processing.
- Conduct credit checks on new and existing customers, maintaining appropriate credit limits and payment terms.
- Process and administer authorised credit notes in line with company procedures.
- Produce weekly reports on aged debt, customer payments, and unallocated cash to support cash flow forecasting.
- Manage inter-company invoicing and ensure balances are reconciled and settled in a timely manner.
- Support e-commerce accounting activities, including reconciliation of online sales remittances and platform costs.
- Work closely with colleagues to identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within the accounts receivable function.
- Assist with bank reconciliations and daily accounts receivable banking activities.
- Support the wider finance team and assist with ad hoc finance duties when required.

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience within a Credit Control or Accounts Receivable role.
- Strong knowledge of sales ledger management and debt collection procedures.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- High attention to detail and strong reconciliation skills.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume finance environment.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and finance/accounting systems.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively to deadlines.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to join a growing and dynamic business.
- Varied and hands-on finance role.
- Exposure to process improvement projects.
- Supportive and collaborative finance team.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you are an experienced Credit Controller available for a 6-month fixed-term contract and looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today through Reed Accountancy & Finance.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Hereford Full-Time £32,000-£36,000 FTE

The Opportunity

An established multi-site business is seeking a highly organised and experienced Book-Keeper / Senior Finance Assistant to join its Head Office finance team.

This is a hands-on position responsible for ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the transactional finance function. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end activities and ensuring finance processes are completed accurately and efficiently.

This opportunity offers flexibility, with both full-time and part-time applicants considered. For this organisation, finding the right individual is more important than a rigid working pattern.

In addition to managing the transactional finance workload, you will take responsibility for coordinating and supporting a junior member of the team, helping to create an efficient, well-organised and collaborative finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing purchase ledger activities and supplier invoice processing.
- Ensuring accurate coding of expenditure and financial transactions.
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations.
- Performing bank and account reconciliations.
- Resolving invoice discrepancies, supplier queries and credit note issues.
- Preparing payment runs and maintaining payment schedules.
- Maintaining accurate supplier and financial records.
- Ensuring all transactional processing is completed in a timely manner to support month-end deadlines.
- Liaising with external finance partners and internal stakeholders.
- Identifying opportunities to improve finance processes and controls.
- Supporting the implementation of more efficient systems and ways of working.
- Coordinating the day-to-day workload of a junior finance team member.
- Delegating tasks effectively and monitoring completion.
- Providing guidance, support and ongoing development to less experienced colleagues.

About You

We are looking for an individual who combines strong accounts experience with excellent organisation and communication skills.

You will ideally have:
- Previous bookkeeping, purchase ledger or accounts administration experience.
- Strong understanding of transactional finance processes.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines consistently.
- Confidence in reviewing work and providing support to junior colleagues.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Experience using accounting software and Excel.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.
- High levels of professionalism, discretion and accountability.

Experience within a multi-site business environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,000-£36,000 FTE, depending on experience.
- Full-time or part-time working options available.
- Minimum commitment of three days per week.
- A varied and autonomous role with genuine responsibility.
- Opportunity to help shape and improve finance processes.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Long-term career development within a growing organisation.

If you are an organised finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, improving processes and supporting others to succeed, we would be delighted to hear from you.
